rationale: All deterministic behavior passes across template save, case-insensitive uniqueness and lookup, alphabetical listing, inheritance and explicit overrides, missing-template atomicity, removal, JSON cleanliness, and banner integration. Atomic task and template persistence are consolidated into a reusable helper with cleanup, and validation, lookup, path selection, and banner output are sensibly factored. The manual extraction of a template sub-action and the enlarged switch add some complexity, but behavior and help integration remain coherent. The symmetric plus-sign frame, prominent TEMPLATE CONTROL CENTER title, and SAVE | LIST | REMOVE line make the subject immediately recognizable and readable; spacing is deliberate, though several blank rows make it slightly less information-dense. The .gitattributes addition is related to asset newline stability, but it is an extra repository-level change, so cleanliness is strong rather than exceptional.
